newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech IPB tender shortlist seen soon - CTK.
newsitem.headline: Czech IPB tender shortlist seen soon - CTK.

text.p: The Czech state privatisation agency, the National Property Fund (NPF), said on Tuesday a shortlist of bidders for a one-third stake in bank IPB a.s. by the end of April, the CTK news agency reported.

CTK quoted NPF Vice-chairman Michal Hruby as saying the whole process of the selloff of 31.5 percent state stake and 4.45 percent stake of state-run post service Ceska Posta s.p. should be finalised by mid-year.
The government has picked the U.S.-based investment bank Salomon Brothers to arrange the selloff, including drawing up the short-list.
"Serious and high quality investors, which we could imagine as IPB's strategic partners, are largely represented among the interested parties," CTK quoted Hruby as saying.
NPF chairman Roman Ceska, who does not have a seat in the cabinet which must approve the sale, has said Japanese investment bank Nomura had the "best chance" to win the tender.
Czech media have also said Dutch ING Groep NV and ABN AMRO as parties are interested in taking a stake in IPB, although both have refused to comment on the matter.
